name: P-Duke Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Founded in 1992, P-Duke Technology Co.,Ltd. operates from its headquarters in Taichung, Taiwan. The company is a specialist in the comprehensive development, manufacturing, sales, and support of DC/DC converters and associated power conversion products, serving markets across Europe, the United States, and Japan. Under its P-DUKE brand, the firm’s diverse portfolio includes AC-DC power supplies, DC-DC converters, medical-grade DC-DC and AC-DC solutions, railway power systems, and surge suppression modules.
